source: Speckle magnitude difference at 880 nm from Endl et al. 2016, ApJ 818, 34 (arXiv:1512.02965), Tables 8-9; Hipparcos V and V-I of the unresolved A+C (ESA 1997, I/239); Mamajek's dwarf table (Pecaut & Mamajek 2013; online version 2022.04.16)
quote: Table 8 (generic point source deconvolution): '692 91.8 0.155 4.13' / '880 91.5 0.158 3.80'; Table 9 (psi1 Dra B as point source): '692 91.8 0.156 4.22' / '880 91.3 0.158 3.71' (filter nm, PA deg, sep arcsec, magnitude difference mag). Hipparcos: '86614	 4.57	  45.38	  0.82	 0.434	 0.50	F5IV-V'
derivation: Treat the DSSI 880-nm Delta m as Delta I: Delta I = 3.755 (mean of 3.71 and 3.80). I(A+C) = V - (V-I) = 4.57 - 0.50 = 4.07 (Hipparcos). I_A = 4.07 + 2.5 log10(1 + 10^(-0.4 x 3.755)) = 4.104; I_C = 7.859. Workbook distance 74.1 ly = 22.72 pc, DM = 1.782 -> M_I(C) = 6.077. Interpolating Mamajek M_I = Mv - (V-Ic) between K5V (6.008, Mbol 6.65) and K6V (6.22, Mbol 6.89): Mbol = 6.73 -> L = 10^((4.74 - 6.73)/2.5) = 0.160 L_sun (0.153 for Delta = 3.80, 0.168 for 3.71). Range widened to 0.13-0.20 for the 880-nm-vs-I_C band mismatch. Check: Gullikson's Teff 4400 K corresponds to Mamajek K5V (4440 K, logL -0.76 -> 0.17).
notes: No luminosity published (Gullikson et al. 2015 give mass and an isochrone Teff only). The speckle detection is 'nearly 5-sigma' (Endl et al. 2016 text). psi1 Dra A's own Hipparcos plx 45.38 / HIP2 43.79 mas vs workbook 22.72 pc (44.0 mas): the workbook distance was used. Inferred value: ORANGE.
